contentBlocks.text: Below is the complete list of SASSA social grant amounts for 2026. Amounts are reviewed annually and may increase with the national budget.
This guide is for anyone who wants to see a complete overview of all current SASSA grant amounts in one place.
Grant amounts are subject to change based on the national budget announcement. The amounts listed above are current as of July 2026.
